lesson_title: Five Ways to Fill a Plate
hook_text: Buy it, grow it, collect it, catch it or hunt it. There are only five ways to get food.
clip_script: Durban: Thandeka's mother buys vegetables at the market. Limpopo: Rendani's grandmother grows maize and collects marula fruit from the veld. Paternoster, on the West Coast: Jacob's father catches snoek from his little boat. Long ago, San hunters followed eland across the Karoo. Buying, growing, collecting, fishing, hunting. Five ways to fill a plate, and most families use more than one.
visual_style: Whiteboard plate in the middle with five arrows pointing in from a shop, a garden, a tree, a boat and a bow and arrow.
mood: Lively and curious, like a tour around the country.
pacing: One family per way of getting food, then all five arrows meeting on the plate.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find out which ways your family uses to get its food.
